item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Cost management and tagging for Claude models in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now includes Claude model charges in Azure Cost Management with the rest of Foundry spend, and this is generally available. Previously, Claude charges were shown under SaaS instead of the Foundry resource used for deployment.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Claude Sonnet 5.5 in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Claude Sonnet 5.5 is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for well-scoped everyday tasks such as building features and fixing bugs.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it can be used for agentic coding, long-running agentic tasks, and knowledge work.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry: July and August 2026
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry’s July and August 2026 update adds stable Hosted Agent and Toolbox SDK paths, Claude tools support on Azure-hosted deployments, and Model Router updates. It also notes local inference improvements and SDK migration items to review before upgrading.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: ai: From single call to agents: five new Claude capabilities now available in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now supports five new Claude capabilities on Azure-hosted models: structured outputs, web search, web fetch, MCP connector, and tool search. The update positions a model endpoint for agent-style workflows rather than single-call usage.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog
